C0299.title: Adversarial Defense Against Bandwidth Depletion DDoS Attacks
C0299.summary: The 2007 Third International Conference on Natural Computation included the paper Research on Counter Bandwidth Depletion DDoS Attacks Based on Genetic Algorithm. It proposed using a genetic algorithm to help routers filter bandwidth-depletion DDoS traffic, a class of attacks that consumes victim network bandwidth with large volumes of unwanted traffic.
